sentences.l: and has to-the Hans as reward much of the gold given, that in the chest been was, and besides still all manner of things, such-as cows and sheep and goats.
sentences.i: and gave Hans as a reward much of the gold that was in the chest, and all manner of other things besides — cows and sheep and goats.
sentences.n: Belohnig = Belohnung; vill = viel; “e der Chiste” = in der Kiste; “aller derhand für Sache” = allerhand für Sachen; Chüe = Kühe; Schoof = Schafe; Gäiße = Geißen, goats. The reward is counted in livestock, which is what wealth looked like where this tale was told.

sentences.t: Wo der Hans zum Chönig cho isch mit deme Sache alle, mit dem Gäld und dem Gold und Silber und dene Chüene, Schoofe und Gäiße,
sentences.l: When the Hans to-the king come was with those things all, with the money and the gold and silver and those cows, sheep and goats,
sentences.i: When Hans came to the king with all these things, with the money and the gold and silver and the cows, sheep and goats,
sentences.n: deme Sache = den Sachen; Gäld = Geld; Chüene = Kühen. The list is repeated in full a second time, and the repetition is the tale showing the reader the king’s face.

sentences.t: so frogt ne der Chönig, woner au das alles übercho heb.
sentences.l: so asks him the king, where-he indeed all that got had.
sentences.i: the king asked him where he had come by it all.
sentences.n: “übercho heb” = überkommen habe, had got — the same überkommen that has run through the tale in the king’s own conditions.

sentences.t: Do säit der Hans der Vogelgrif gäb äin so vill me well.
sentences.l: Then says the Hans the Vogel Greif gave one so much one wanted.
sentences.i: Hans said the Vogel Greif gave one as much as one liked.
sentences.n: äin = einem; me = man, one; well = wolle. Hans answers truthfully and without a word of advice, and everything that follows is the king’s own doing.

sentences.t: Do dänkt der Chönig er chönt das au bruche und macht se au uf der Weg zum Vogelgrif,
sentences.l: Then thinks the king he could that also use and makes himself also onto the road to the Vogel Greif,
sentences.i: Then the king thought that he could use some of that too, and he also set out for the Vogel Greif,
sentences.n: chönt = könnte; bruche = brauchen, to use, to have a use for. The king takes the same road for the same reason, and the tale gives him no warning at all.

sentences.t: aber woner zue dem Wasser cho isch, so isch er halt der erst gsi, der sid em Hans cho isch,
sentences.l: but when-he to the water come was, so was he just the first been, who since the Hans come is,
sentences.i: but when he came to the water he happened to be the first who had come since Hans,
sentences.n: halt, the particle of resignation, is doing quiet work here: it makes the king’s arrival a matter of plain bad luck. erst = erste; sid = seit.

sentences.t: un de Ma stellt e z’ mitzt ab und goht furt, und der Chönig isch ertrunke.
sentences.l: and the man sets him at midst down and goes away, and the king is drowned.
sentences.i: and the man set him down in the middle and went off, and the king was drowned.
sentences.n: “stellt e … ab” = stellt ihn ab, sets him down, with the particle ab at the end; ertrunke = ertrunken. The tale kills the king in half a line and does not pause over it; nothing is softened here either.

sentences.t: Der Hans het do d’ Tochter ghürothet und isch Chönig worde.
sentences.l: The Hans has then the daughter married and is king become.
sentences.i: So Hans married the daughter and became king.
sentences.n: ghürothet = geheiratet; worde = worden. The promise that was made in the third sense-unit of the tale and broken three times is kept at last, and by the king’s death rather than by his word.

glossary.a: an — at, on, to (‘träg se a Hof’ = trag sie an den Hof); also the particle of annehmen and anfangen (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.aller: aller- — in ‘aller derhand’ = allerhand, all manner of (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.an: an — at, on (‘an Öpfle’ = an Äpfeln); also the separable particle of anfragen (‘froget ne an’ = fragt ihn an) and, in ‘is an der Schloß’, part of ander, other (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ane: hin — thither, whither (‘wo si Räis ane geu’ = wohin seine Reise gehe; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.anner: ander — other (‘der anner Tag’ = der andere Tag; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.begegnet: begegnen — meets; met (3rd sg. present and past participle; takes the dative)
glossary.bricht: der Bericht — news, word (Swiss German (Alemannic); spelled Bericht as well)
glossary.bringe: bringen — to bring (infinitive; also 3rd pl. present)
glossary.brocht: bringen — brought (past participle, gebracht, without the ge-; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.bös: böse — angry, cross (‘bös worde’ = böse geworden, grew angry)
glossary.d: d’ = die, der, das — the (the article reduced to a single letter before a noun; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.dar: daran — thereon, on them (‘gsund dar esse’ = sich daran gesund essen; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.dat: das — that (Swiss German (Alemannic); the tale writes das everywhere else, and dat only twice)
glossary.de: der, die, das; du — the; who, which; and, leaning on a verb, *du*, you (‘de hesch traumet’ = du hast geträumt; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.denn: denn; dann — for, because; also *dann*, then (Swiss German (Alemannic) uses denn for both)
glossary.des: dem — the (dat.; ‘e des z’ friede’ = in dem zufrieden — not the genitive des; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.di: die — the (pl.; ‘o di Nare’ = o die Narren; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.do: da, dort; dann — there, then (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.e: ein; in; er, sie, ihn — a, an; also *in* (‘e dem Chratte’ = in dem Kratten) and a worn-down pronoun (‘stellt e ab’ = stellt ihn ab; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ehr: ihr — you (polite plural, nominative; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.em: ihm; dem — (to) him; the (dat. masc./neut.; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.emol: einmal — once (‘no emol’ = noch einmal; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ene: einen — a, one (masc. acc.; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ere: ihr; einer; er e — (to) her; also *einer* (fem.); and in ‘daß ere Fädere sölt ha’ it is er e, he a (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.erzürnt: erzürnen — angered, enraged (past participle; ‘das het ne erzürnt’ = das hat ihn erzürnt)
glossary.es: es; ein — it; also the neuter article *ein* (‘es Manndle’ = ein Männlein; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.fest: fest — fast, sound (adv.; ‘rächt fest schlofe’ = recht fest schlafen, to sleep soundly — not das Fest, a feast)
glossary.friede: zufrieden — content, satisfied (in ‘z’ friede si’ = zufrieden sein; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.froget: fragen — ask (2nd pl. imperative; ‘froget ne an’ = fragt ihn an, separable; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.frogt: fragen — asks (3rd sg. present; Swiss German (Alemannic) = fragt)
glossary.früe: früh — early (‘am Morge früe’ = am Morgen früh; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.fürs: vor das — before the, in front of the (Swiss German (Alemannic) für regularly stands for High German vor)
glossary.gang: gehen — go! (imperative sg.; Swiss German (Alemannic) = geh)
glossary.gange: gehen — gone (past participle, gegangen; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.gar: gar, sehr — quite, thoroughly (an intensifier: ‘gar grüsele’ = ganz gewaltig)
glossary.ghört: hören — heard (past participle, gehört; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.glaubt: glauben — believed (past participle, geglaubt, without the ge-; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.glich: gleich — the same, alike (‘es isch em glich gange’ = es ist ihm gleich ergangen)
glossary.gliche: gleich — the same, alike (inflected; not a form of gleichen)
glossary.goht: gehen — goes (3rd sg. present; Swiss German (Alemannic) = geht)
glossary.gsund: gesund — well, healthy (Swiss German (Alemannic) gsund = gesund)
glossary.gäb: geben — would give (3rd sg. subjunctive, gäbe)
glossary.ha: haben — to have (infinitive; Swiss German (Alemannic) ha = haben, not the exclamation ha)
glossary.haas: der Hase — hare (Swiss German (Alemannic) Haas = Hase)
glossary.halt: halt — just, simply (the southern particle of resignation; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.he: hin; he! — whither (‘woner he well’ = wo er hin wolle); also as an opener, he!, well (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.heb: haben — has (3rd sg. subjunctive of reported speech, habe; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.het: haben — has (3rd sg.; Swiss German (Alemannic) = hat)
glossary.hett: haben — has (3rd sg.; Swiss German (Alemannic) = hat)
glossary.ho: haben — (I) have (1st sg.; Swiss German (Alemannic) = habe)
glossary.hob: haben — has (3rd sg. subjunctive of reported speech, habe; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.hus: das Haus — house (Swiss German (Alemannic) Hus = Haus)
glossary.händ: haben — have (3rd pl.; Swiss German (Alemannic) = haben, not Hände)
glossary.i: ich; in; ein — I; also *in* (‘e dem Chratte’ has e, but ‘i d’ Stube’ has i) and the particle *ein* (‘er sitzt i’ = er sitzt ein; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ine: hinein — in, inside (‘ine lo’ = hinein lassen; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.is: ins (in das) — into the (‘is Holz’ = ins Holz; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.isch: sein — is (3rd sg.; Swiss German (Alemannic) = ist; with gsi it forms the perfect that does duty for the simple past)
glossary.jage: jagen — to chase, to drive (infinitive; ‘zum Hus us jage’ = zum Haus hinausjagen)
glossary.kerle: der Kerl — fellow, lad (sg. with the southern -e; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.lauf: laufen — run away (3rd sg. subjunctive, laufe)
glossary.laufe: laufen — to run, to run away (infinitive; also subjunctive pl.)
glossary.länge: langen — to reach (‘use länge’ = hinauslangen, to reach out; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ma: der Mann — man (Swiss German (Alemannic) Ma = Mann, not man, one)
glossary.mach: machen — was doing (3rd sg. subjunctive, mache)
glossary.me: man; mir; mehr — one; also *mir*, to me, and *mehr*, more (‘käine me’ = keinen mehr; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.meh: mehr — more (‘dere Sache meh’ = solcher Sachen mehr; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.mi: mein — my (nom. masc.; ‘mi guete Fründ’ = mein guter Freund; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.mol: mal — time, once (‘none mol’ = noch einmal; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.na: nach — to, toward (‘na Hof’ = nach Hof; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ne: ihn; ’ne = einen, eine — him (acc.); also the reduced article a, an (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.ner: ihr — you (pl.; ‘die ner wüße söttet’ = die ihr wissen solltet; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.no: noch; nach; nun — still, yet; also *nach* (‘nit no glo’ = nicht nachgelassen); and as an opener, well then (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.numme: nicht mehr, nimmer — no longer (‘chönnene numme finde’ = könnten ihn nicht mehr finden; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.obe: der Abend — evening (‘z’ Obe’ = zu Abend, in the evening; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.paßt: aufpassen — watches, keeps watch (3rd sg., separable: paßt … uf; 1857 spelling of passt)
glossary.s: ’s = es, das; des — it, the; also the genitive article (‘s’ Vogelgrife Stehl’ = des Vogel Greifs Schweif; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.schafft: schaffen — works, labours (3rd sg.; schaffen in its southern sense of working)
glossary.se: sie; sich — she, they, them; also the reflexive *sich* (‘het se gfreut’ = hat sich gefreut; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.seit: sagen — says (3rd sg.; the tale’s usual spelling is säit; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.si: sein; sie — his (possessive); to be (infinitive); also *sie*, they (Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.so: so — so, thus, then; also *wie*, such as (‘so Chüe und Schoof’ = wie Kühe und Schafe), and once a worn-down *sie*, she (‘fot so no a’ = fängt sie noch an; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.stand: der Stand — state, condition (‘im Stand si’ = imstande sein, to be able)
glossary.stellt: abstellen — sets down (3rd sg., separable: stellt … ab)
glossary.störe: stören — to disturb (infinitive; ‘nid lo störe’ = nicht stören lassen)
glossary.säge: sagen — say (3rd pl. present and infinitive; Swiss German (Alemannic) = sagen)
glossary.sö: so — so, then (‘sö froget ne an’ = so fragt ihn an; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.söll: sollen — shall, is to (3rd sg., soll/solle; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.söllt: sollen — should (3rd sg. subjunctive, sollte; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.treibt: treiben — drives (3rd sg.; of driving animals along)
glossary.tritt: der Tritt — step, stair-tread (‘dem underste Tritt’ = der untersten Stufe)
glossary.up: auf — on, onto (Swiss German (Alemannic); the tale writes uf elsewhere)
glossary.us: aus — out of (‘zum Hus us’ = zum Haus hinaus; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.use: hinaus, heraus — out (‘use länge’ = hinauslangen, to reach out; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.vele: vielen — many (‘mit vele Freude’ = mit vielen Freuden; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.weg: der Weg — way, road (‘der Weg under d’ Füeß neh’ = sich auf den Weg machen); in ‘äine weg’ = einerweg, all the same
glossary.weiß: wissen — (I) know (1st sg.; ‘weiß i nümme’ = weiß ich nicht mehr)
glossary.well: wollen — wants, would (1st/3rd sg. and subjunctive wolle; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.welle: wollen — wanted to (past participle in the double infinitive: ‘het welle’ = hat wollen; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.werd: werden — would become (3rd sg. subjunctive of reported speech, werde; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.wers: werden — will be (‘so wers se gsund’ = so wird sie gesund; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.wo: wo; als — where; also *als*, when (‘wo d’ Sunne am höchste gstande isch’ = als die Sonne am höchsten stand; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.woll: wohl — surely, right enough (‘e woll’ = ei wohl, oh yes; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.worde: werden — become, been (past participle, (ge)worden; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.wos: wo es (als es) — when it (‘wos am heißeste gsi isch’ = als es am heißesten gewesen ist; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.wäre: werden — to become (infinitive; ‘und wäre Chönig’ = und werden König; Swiss German (Alemannic))
glossary.über: über — over, across; also the particle of überkommen, to come by, to get (‘chunt er se über’ = überkommt er sie)
